title: Luxury 1 RWD
infotainment: 33-inch curved LED display (combined instrument + infotainment), Google built-in
adasStandard: Forward collision warning, automatic emergency braking, pedestrian detection, lane-keep assist, blind-spot monitoring, rear cross-traffic alert, HD rear-view camera. Source: [Edmunds 2025 Lyriq specs](https://www.edmunds.com/cadillac/lyriq/2025/features-specs/).
adasOptional: Super Cruise (Cadillac hands-free highway driver assist) — included on Luxury 2/3 and Sport 2/3, optional standalone on Luxury 1/Sport 1. Source: [Cadillac.com Super Cruise](https://www.cadillac.com/world-of-cadillac/innovation/super-cruise).
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard HD rear-view camera with dynamic guidelines.
sideViewCameraNotes: Surround-view 360 camera available on higher trims (Luxury 2/3, Sport 2/3). Standard on Luxury 1 is rear-only.
subscriptionFeatures: OnStar Connect ($9.99/mo MY2025+), Connect Plus ($24.99/mo for Wi-Fi hotspot/video), Protect ($19.99/mo for safety/roadside/stolen-vehicle assist), OnStar One bundle ($49.99/mo excl Super Cruise). Super Cruise: 3 years included, then ~$25/mo or yearly. Sources: [OnStar pricing](https://www.onstar.com/pricing).
drmNotes: Car operates standalone (drive, climate, native nav) without an active subscription. Connected services (remote start via app, in-car streaming apps, Wi-Fi hotspot, OTA navigation updates, Super Cruise map updates) require active OnStar subscription. Super Cruise hands-free assist requires subscription after included trial. Sources: [OnStar pricing](https://www.onstar.com/pricing).
killSwitchNotes: No impaired-driving kill switch currently present. Driver-monitoring camera supports Super Cruise; could be repurposed for the IIJA Section 24220 mandate when it takes effect (~MY2027). Sources: [The Autopian on IIJA](https://www.theautopian.com/new-cars-sold-in-america-will-be-actively-watching-and-judging-you-and-may-decide-to-not-let-you-drive/).
knownIssues: Software/electronics issues are the biggest reliability driver per CR. Charging-related and blank-display defects in early 2025 builds. Sources: [Consumer Reports 2025 Lyriq](https://www.consumerreports.org/cars/cadillac/lyriq/2025/reliability/), [WardsAuto blank-display recall](https://www.wardsauto.com/news/archive-auto-gm-recalls-41k-cadillac-lyriq-blank-instrument-panel-displays-nhtsa/750990/).
recalls: 2025 Lyriq has 3 NHTSA recalls including: rear head-restraint owner-manual non-compliance with FMVSS 202; high-voltage battery mounting bolts that may be missing/loose. Sources: [NHTSA 2025 Lyriq](https://www.nhtsa.gov/vehicle/2025/CADILLAC/LYRIQ/SUV/RWD), [Cars.com Lyriq recalls](https://www.cars.com/research/cadillac-lyriq/recalls/).
stateIncentives: Varies by state; eligible for California CVRP-replacement program where applicable. Source: [Cadillac Lyriq tax credit info](https://www.tustincadillac.com/which-cadillac-vehicles-are-eligible-for-tax-rebates/).

adasStandard: Super Cruise standard, full ADAS suite (FCW, AEB, BSM, RCTA, LKA, adaptive cruise).
adasOptional: Night Vision available on higher trims.
rearViewCameraNotes: HD rear-view camera with dynamic guidelines.
sideViewCameraNotes: Surround-view 360 camera standard.
subscriptionFeatures: OnStar Connect/Connect Plus/Protect/OnStar One; Super Cruise 3-year trial.
drmNotes: Brand-new model. Same OnStar/Super Cruise subscription model as Lyriq/Optiq/Escalade IQ. Battery-bolt recall shared with 2025 Lyriq.
knownIssues: NHTSA recall for 2026 Vistiq: high-voltage battery mounting bolts may be missing/loose. Source: [SafeCarInfo 2025 Lyriq recall](https://www.safecarinfo.com/cars/cadillac/lyriq/2025).
recalls: Battery-bolt recall (high-voltage battery may not be properly secured).
